$comment: The house brand. This is what the product wears when it is selling itself:
the marketing site, the platform-admin console, the demo tenant, and the
'powered by' line in every customer's footer.
Sourced from ifBash Brand Guidelines, Brick & Charcoal edition, 2026-07-27.
Section references below point at that document. Do not drift the accent
colours without a client decision — six directions have already been
rejected and are listed in section 9 of the guidelines.

color.$comment: Guidelines section 3. 'sea' is the brick red, 'sky' the azure AI layer.
color.$overrides_note: Values sections 3.1 of the guidelines pin exactly, so they are not left to derivation. Light mode only — the dark equivalents are derived, because an ink fixed for paper is ink on ink against a dark ground.

type.$comment: Guidelines section 4. One superfamily; hierarchy by weight and size only.

assets.$comment: Guidelines section 2.2. Never recolour or redraw these.

copy.tagline: The alumni network your college actually owns.
copy.heroHeadline: Your alumni are not a mailing list.
copy.heroSubhead: A verified directory, a working referral channel between final-years and graduates, and a records layer that survives the person who set it up. Built for Indian engineering colleges, on infrastructure that stays in India.
